Question: On the trip home from the meeting where this AMC \(10\) was constructed, the Contest Chair noted that his airport parking receipt had digits of the form \(bbcac,\) where \(0\le a\lt b\lt c\le 9,\) and \(b\) was the average of \(a\) and \(c.\) How many different five-digit numbers satisfy all these properties?
